_doc: Emberlight style baseline for tests/client_smoke/style_check.gd (art bible, Colour). shots: the noon and night spawn shots' colour measures (llvmpipe, 1280x720, HUD masked). big: a move this far away from the art bible fails the Test check. small: a move this far either way is printed for the integrator. A world PR that changes the look on purpose reruns the check with --write-baseline and says so. 2026-11-24, grounded art direction (owner direction, art bible sections 0 and 11): baseline rewritten on purpose. Noon is darker and far less saturated (olive, not lime: luma 0.74 -> 0.54, sat 0.43 -> 0.30), and night moved toward the art bible (blue over green, cool, neon share 0.62 -> ~0.05). 2026-11-24, night lighting fix (PR #181, owner playtest): night baseline rewritten on purpose. The old night numbers were measured with a bug: every lantern added the cool SHADE tint to everything in its range (on real GPUs, whole Forward+ light-cluster tiles: the blocky cyan pool), which on this Compatibility-renderer shot showed as a cyan-green wash. With the wash gone the CI night shot is darker and deeper blue (luma 0.14 -> 0.05, sat 0.68 -> 0.93, neon 0.09 -> 0.03, bluer). Forward+ (players' GPUs) reads moonlit blue with warm lantern pools; the Compatibility renderer under-lights night (pines and figures near black, preexisting): world backlog follow-up.
